landRecords.sub: Official Maharashtra revenue portals and automated extract analyzer
landRecords.legalNoticeText: LandLens AI connects directly with authorized, publicly accessible Maharashtra State portals. In accordance with government policy and data privacy regulations, official land records must be verified on Mahabhulekh. Bulk automated scraping of survey numbers without official government API authorization is strictly not supported.
landRecords.aiAssistantSub: Upload your legally obtained 7/12 extract or Nakasha for automated parameter extraction and verification.
landRecords.occupantNote: Note: Ownership on record does not imply willingness to sell.

landRecords.privacyCertText: Uploaded extracts remain encrypted and private to your account. LandLens AI does not publish personal landowner contact or identity data publicly.
